results.description:
Enhance Your Driving Experience with Speed Tracker Speed Tracker is the ultimate app for car enthusiasts and performance drivers who want to monitor and analyze their driving with precision. Whether you're on a road trip, testing your car's limits, or simply commuting, Speed Tracker provides the insights you need to optimize your driving experience. All core features work out of the box - no account or subscription required.

Key Features:

Real-Time Driving Metrics:

Track your current speed, average speed, and maximum speed in real-time.
Monitor your journey with precise GPS location updates, even when the app is running in the background.
Follow your trip from the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island with Live Activities, including distance, duration, average speed, and ETA status.
Optionally auto-start trips when you begin driving and end them when you park - even if the app was closed.

Shortcuts & Automation:
Set up CarPlay automations to automatically track trips when you connect or disconnect from your car.
Control tracking with Siri voice commands and Apple Shortcuts.

In-Depth Trip Analysis:
Access detailed summaries of each trip, including start and end times, total distance, and duration.
Analyze your route with comprehensive speed data and GPS coordinates.
Calculate estimated travel times and compare them with actual durations to gain insights into your travel efficiency and identify areas for improvement.
Create share cards from any trip - polished route, compact, or overlay graphics ready to send to friends or post online.

Interactive Map Visualizations:
Visualize your routes on a dynamic map with speed-based coloring to identify high-speed segments.
Customize speed ranges for map coloring, or use Autobahn-optimized presets.

Comprehensive Driving Statistics:
View detailed statistics on total distance, duration, average speed, and top speed.
Explore highlights, ETA comparison, cruising insights, streaks, and tag breakdowns.
Identify high-speed segments with customizable speed thresholds, perfect for performance analysis.

Trip History & Management:
Browse through your trip history with advanced sorting and filtering options.
Tag trips for better organization and quick access.
Sync and back up your trips with iCloud for seamless access across all your devices.

Speed Tracker Social (subscription required):
Share your trips with friends or drivers worldwide and see how you compare.
Watch friends - and drivers sharing worldwide - live on the map with real-time speed, route, and ETA.
Auto-share completed drives with friends and get alerts when someone is driving live.
React to shared trips, build your driver profile, connect with friends, and explore their drives.
Add cars to your Garage and attach them when you share.
Compare on global and country leaderboards in categories like total distance, peak speed, drive time, average speed, ETA comparison, and longest trip.
Social features require a monthly or yearly subscription. All core tracking, analysis, and statistics features remain fully available without a subscription.

Why Choose Speed Tracker? Speed Tracker is specifically designed for car drivers who demand precision and detail in their driving data. Whether you're aiming to improve your driving performance, track your road trips, or simply keep a log of your daily commutes, Speed Tracker provides the tools you need to gain valuable insights and make informed decisions. With Live Activities, smarter statistics, share cards, and optional auto-start tracking, every drive is easier to follow and revisit. And with Speed Tracker Social - including Live Drives, auto-share, and leaderboards - you can join a community of drivers, share your trips, and see how others drive.

Download Speed Tracker today and take your driving experience to the next level!
